svg.title: HousingFinder — Level 1 data flow diagram
svg.desc: Six Level 1 processes exchange labeled data with human actors, external map/translation services, and six logical data stores. Repeated store identifiers refer to the same store.

text.tspan: Boundary: application + Supabase Auth, PostgreSQL and Storage. Google services are external.
Entity/store symbols repeat by identifier to keep flows readable. Arrows name data, not control steps.
